title: Spain Study Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Fees, IELTS & FAQ | SK Immigration
description: Spain study visa from Pakistan (Schengen / EU): requirements, documents, fees, IELTS, low marks, timeline and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: What are Spain study visa requirements from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Admission from a recognized Spanish university or school; Proof of funds for living costs; Health insurance without co-payments as typically required; Passport, forms, photos. SK Immigration builds a full checklist for your case.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to study in Spain from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Budget tuition + living + visa/insurance. Spain is generally more affordable than UK/Canada for many programmes. SK packages from PKR 50,000 cover preparation only — not tuition.

faqs.question: Do I need IELTS for Spain study visa?
faqs.answer: English programmes usually need IELTS/TOEFL; Spanish-taught need DELE/SIELE or university proof.

faqs.question: Can I study in Spain with low marks?
faqs.answer: Selective public unis vs more flexible private options — we map honestly.

faqs.question: How long does Spain student visa take from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Often 3–7 months depending on legalization and slots.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for Spain student visa?
faqs.answer: Passport pack; Acceptance letter; Funds proof; Insurance policy; Academics; Criminal record if asked.

faqs.question: Can I work while studying in Spain?
faqs.answer: Limited student work may be allowed after residence authorization — verify current hours.

faqs.question: How to apply for Spain study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Secure admission, prepare funds/insurance/docs, then file the correct national/student visa. SK Immigration sequences the file; authorities decide.

faqs.question: What is SK Immigration’s fee for Spain study?
faqs.answer: Student packages from PKR 50,000 for preparation. Embassy and university fees are separate. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee Spain student visa approval?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and immigration authorities decide. We prepare complete, honest files.

Spain student visa from Pakistan

Spain appeals for Spanish- and English-taught options and EU living experience. Long-stay student visas need admission, funds, insurance and a mission-ready document set. Spanish consular posts decide; SK Immigration sequences the file.

Eligibility checklist (verify current mission list)

  • Acceptance from a recognized Spanish school / university
  • Funds and tuition evidence
  • Medical insurance meeting stated coverage rules
  • Accommodation proof when required
  • Language evidence matching the programme (Spanish DELE/SIELE pathways or English tests — only as required)

Application flow

  1. Shortlist and apply
  2. Secure admission / enrolment letter
  3. Compile civil + academic + financial set
  4. Book appointment only when documents are complete
  5. Await decision — do not travel on assumptions

Pakistan-file mistakes

  • Assuming tourist entry can convert casually into study residence
  • Insurance that does not meet stated minimums
  • Incomplete apostille/attestation chains
  • Generic SOPs with no Spain-specific programme logic
